name: create_note
description: write a note in the user's Notes app: a summary of the conversation, a list of tasks, a short text on a subject.
examples: Résume cette conversation dans une note
Crée une note qui résume les documents du projet Atlas
Fais une note avec les points à retenir de la politique de télétravail

content.description: the note itself, in full, in Markdown, without its title

instructions: A note is concise: organize it with short "##" sections or lists. Keep what matters, nothing more. The content is in Markdown: headings, paragraphs, "- " and "1. " lists, **bold** and *italic*; no table, no code block, no link. It starts with its first section or paragraph, never with the title, which is in its own field. No introduction like "Here is", no comment after it.

name: create_document
description: write a text document (OnlyOffice, like Word) saved in the user's files: a report, a meeting summary, an article, a document on a subject. Choose it rather than a note when the user asks for a document, a doc, a report, Word or OnlyOffice.
examples: Écris un document sur les bonnes pratiques du télétravail
Fais un compte rendu de cette conversation dans un document
Write a report on the progress of the Atlas project from my files

content.description: the document itself, in full, in Markdown, without its title

instructions: A document is complete: an introduction, then "##" sections developed in full sentences, with lists where they help, and a short conclusion. The content is in Markdown: headings, paragraphs, "- " and "1. " lists, **bold** and *italic*; no table, no code block, no link. It starts with its first section or paragraph, never with the title, which is in its own field. No introduction like "Here is", no comment after it.

name: draft_email
description: prepare an email for the user to review and send: a reply, a message to someone, a summary to share.
examples: Rédige un mail à Paul pour lui envoyer ce résumé
Write an email to the team about the delivery delay

to.description: the recipients, as the user named them (names or email addresses)

instructions: The body is plain text, ready to send, with a greeting and a sign-off, without a signature name. When the user asks to send a summary or an answer of the conversation, the body contains it in full.
